ranked.headline: Machine learning models predict drug response and treatment failure in cancer
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply interpretable, foundation-model, and benchmarking approaches to tumor and single-cell data for therapy outcome prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational models infer spatial gene activity from tissue imaging and transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend spatial transcriptomics models toward causal inference, batch-bias detection, foundation models, and 3D augmentation.

ranked.headline: Graph models and open tools for mining protein interfaces and glycan 3D structures
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published package apply graph representations and atomic-level features to interface and glycan structure mining.

ranked.headline: Simulators and benchmarks are testing variant and modification calling limits
ranked.summary: Simulation-based ground truth and systematic benchmarks now quantify accuracy limits across sequencing-based variant and modification detection.

ranked.headline: Single-cell data attribute genetic and perturbation effects to specific cell types
ranked.summary: Airqtl, SIDISH and iPS2-seq move eQTL, risk and perturbation analyses from bulk averages to cell-state resolution.

ranked.headline: Biology-constrained embeddings for cell typing, regulons, and multi-omic integration
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications couple contrastive, graph, and autoencoder objectives to scRNA-seq, spatial, and microbiome omics data.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks link gut microbial metabolism to host phenotypes and diet
ranked.summary: Genome-scale models and double machine learning now connect gut microbial metabolites to hypertension, diet, and brain disorders at network scale.

ranked.headline: Residue-level energetics and networks resolve protein conformational change and binding
ranked.summary: Simulation now assigns energetic and network roles to individual residues, moving beyond descriptive trajectory analysis.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies link genome architecture to size and demographic history
ranked.summary: Recent chromosome-scale assemblies across flatworms, termites, cattle and scrub-jays enable direct tests of structural and size evolution.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained and enhanced-sampling models generate conformational state ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications couple modeled state populations to scattering and in vivo measurements to parameterize conformational ensembles.

ranked.headline: RNA-binding proteins link exon usage, chromatin marks, and mRNA decay regulation
ranked.summary: RBP binding is now being resolved against histone marks, NMD efficiency, and ribosome density across Drosophila, chicken, glioma, and tumor datasets.

ranked.headline: Explicit computational frameworks map and predict neural responses across modalities
ranked.summary: Connectome, retinotopic, EEG/SEEG/ECoG, and Dale's-law RNN studies now formalize neural mapping and decoding as benchmarked, reusable frameworks.

ranked.headline: Chemical language models and RL drive generative design of synthesizable molecules
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications couple chemical language models with reinforcement learning, synthesis constraints, and 3D diffusion for molecular design.

ranked.headline: Post-calling tools integrate population, phenotypic, and database evidence for variants
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications automate ACMG classification and population-aware annotation of long-read and short-read variants after calling.

ranked.headline: Compact k-mer and minimizer structures are reused for pangenome alignment and sketching
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications target specific sequencing tasks, from ancient DNA pangenome alignment to long-read mapping and variant description.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models and comparative genomics map bacterial metabolic diversity
ranked.summary: Genome-scale models now span thousands of bacterial genomes, linking metabolic capacity to lineage, growth trade-offs, and gene co-evolution.

ranked.headline: Untargeted MS workflows extend peak picking, drug exposure and dereplication
ranked.summary: Untargeted HRMS data processing and spectral libraries now enable direct detection of drug exposures and natural products from raw metabolomic data.

ranked.headline: Standardized benchmarking of transcriptomic gene sets and isoform features across datasets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend explicit, benchmarked scoring of transcriptomic features to isoform-resolved, chromatin, and spatial data.

ranked.headline: Foundation models and knowledge-guided learning advance cancer tissue image analysis
ranked.summary: Pathology foundation models now incorporate reports, gene expression, and knowledge priors, targeting generalization and fairness across cohorts.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale criteria are redrawing bacterial taxonomic boundaries and HGT detection
ranked.summary: Recent work proposes standardized, sequence-derived frameworks for bacterial classification, strain clustering, and gene transfer detection.

ranked.headline: Computational Tracing of Atoms, Stereochemistry and Assembly in Metabolite Chemistry
ranked.summary: Structure-level computation now addresses atom provenance, stereochemical identity, and assembly complexity at natural-product scale.

ranked.headline: Mapping GWAS loci to genes and cell types across psychiatric and migraine studies
ranked.summary: Cohorts of 124,416 individuals and 1.06 million cases now enable cell-type and pleiotropic resolution of GWAS loci, requiring standardized evidence integration.

ranked.headline: Software defines haplotype blocks and crossovers from genotype data for association work
ranked.summary: Haplotype-aware tools now expose local haplotype variants and minor-allele blocks directly to GWAS and genomic selection pipelines.

ranked.headline: Energy-based and physics-guided models extend protein conformational ensemble sampling
ranked.summary: Energy-based models of conformational space and coarse-grained machine-learning potentials are being evaluated for ensemble-level protein modeling.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised and autoencoder models learn biological representations from varied data
ranked.summary: Controlled benchmarks and standardized frameworks now test masking design, encoding strategies, and autoencoder training across biological data types.

ranked.headline: Predictive neoantigen prioritization for vaccines, response scoring and off-target risk
ranked.summary: Multiple 2025 preprints and publications extend neoantigen and HLA-based prediction to vaccine trials, checkpoint response, glioma and CAR T contexts.

ranked.headline: Learned models replace manual annotation in cell microscopy analysis
ranked.summary: Recent work reduces reliance on hand annotation via synthetic training data, foundation models, and self-supervised reconstruction in cell imaging.

ranked.headline: Software tools standardise, benchmark and visualise derived omics and structural outputs
ranked.summary: Multiple December 2025 releases add validation, benchmarking and interactive visualisation layers over derived omics and structural data.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings and fusion models predict genomic, RNA and molecular associations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply foundation models, graph embeddings and meta-classifiers to genome, RNA and interaction prediction across species.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked choices for GPCR free energy, residence time and fragment pre-screening
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication (Dec 2025) present benchmarked, reportable method components for GPCR free energies, residence times and pre-screening.

ranked.headline: Structure-derived models refine residue substitution, energy, and parameter prediction
ranked.summary: Structure-derived and deep learning models are now benchmarked against established baselines for residue substitution, energy, and neoantigen prediction.

ranked.headline: Generative augmentation and transformers address small-data peptide classification
ranked.summary: Small labeled peptide datasets are driving generative augmentation and transformer architectures for peptide function prediction.

ranked.headline: Curated fine-tuning steers language models toward functional protein and plasmid designs
ranked.summary: Protein and DNA language models are being steered by curated training data and structure-prediction filters to yield functional sequences.

ranked.headline: Neural approximation of mechanistic reaction, metabolic, and single-cell dynamics
ranked.summary: Neural models are now fit to or bounded against explicit reaction networks, metabolic time courses, and single-cell trajectories.

ranked.headline: Assay-specific preprocessing and interval tools speed long-read and single-cell genomics
ranked.summary: Long-read RNA-seq and bacterial single-cell datasets now call for preprocessing tuned to assay structure rather than generic throughput.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned design now spans nuclease scaffolds and antibody repertoires
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published workflow apply structure-based generative design to nucleases and antibodies with developability and epitope objectives.

ranked.headline: Curated databases and pipelines for microbial taxonomic profiling and gene catalogs
ranked.summary: Reference resources now pair curated taxonomy, coverage-aware profiling and large gene catalogs to reduce false positives in metagenomic analysis.

ranked.headline: New association methods partition polygenic, epistatic and regulatory genetic effects
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale data now allow tests of co-expression, marginal epistasis and causal gene-regulatory architecture beyond single-trait marginal effects.

ranked.headline: Long-read and single-cell tools probe chromosome architecture across species
ranked.summary: Long-read and single-cell methods now resolve centromeres, telomeres and active X chromosomes across populations and lineages.

ranked.headline: Genealogy-aware inference methods for lineages, population genetics and complex traits
ranked.summary: Recent work extends lineage, neural-network and mixed-model inference to context-dependent mutation, population genetic features and ARG-scale trait data.
